These notes were distilled from earlier work in this repository that passed verification. Follow them unless the code or CHANGELOG.md shows they no longer hold.
- [at-0004] Money operations accept idempotency_key and check it first: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance (e.g. refund in ledgerly/adjustments.py) must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None`, check ledgerly.audit.events() for an existing entry with that key before any state validation, return the original result without reapplying, and include idempotency_key in the audit.record call.
  (learned from task E04 on ledgerly 1.0.0; source INC-204; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0001] Raise BillingError with machine-readable codes: Reject invalid input by raising BillingError(code, detail) from ledgerly.errors, using short snake_case codes like "invalid_state", "invalid_quantity" and "negative_amount"; mirror the state check in payments.authorize.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 1x, 0 passed, 1 failed)
  WARNING: a recent task that relied on this note failed a related review check.
- [at-0005] Refunds above 500.00 require approved_by: Per finance policy FIN-2026-03, support-initiated refunds and credits above 500.00 must accept keyword-only `approved_by=None` and raise BillingError("approval_required") when it is missing; amounts at or below 500.00 need no approval. Define the threshold as APPROVAL_THRESHOLD = round_money("500.00") in ledgerly/adjustments.py.
  (learned from task E04 on ledgerly 1.0.0; source FIN-2026-03; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)

item.title: Money-moving functions take keyword-only idempotency_key
item.content: Functions that move money (authorize, capture) should accept a keyword-only `idempotency_key=None`, scan `audit.events()` for a matching key and return early, and pass `idempotency_key` into `audit.record`.

item.title: Normalize timestamps with ensure_utc
item.content: Store timestamps on models only after passing them through `ledgerly.clock.ensure_utc`; never assign a raw `at` datetime to fields like `captured_at`.
